label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): rubric for alt text and link text in client posts. Anchors are generated practice anchors, not real editor work.
construct: Writing alt text and link text that convey purpose in context

criteria.name: Alt text conveys the image's purpose in context

levels.descriptor: Missing, a filename, or only 'image of'
Describes appearance but not the purpose in this post
Conveys the purpose; misses a key detail or repeats the caption
Conveys purpose and key detail in one or two sentences; decorative images have empty alt text
'Click here', 'read more' or a bare URL
Names a topic but not what opens
Names the destination; long or repeats nearby text
Names the destination and makes sense read alone in a list of links

anchors.rationale: A filename gives a screen-reader user nothing.

anchors.sample: alt="Blue bar chart with five bars"
anchors.rationale: Describes appearance; the post's point (tickets fell) is missing.
Purpose is there; the key detail (420 to 310) is missing.

anchors.sample: alt="Support tickets fell from 420 in March to 310 in April"
anchors.rationale: Purpose and key detail, one sentence.

anchors.sample: Link text: "Read the April support report, which covers ticket volumes for every product line"
anchors.rationale: Names the destination but runs long.

anchors.sample: Link text: "Read the April support report"
anchors.rationale: Names the destination; makes sense alone.
